olderRecordsRequest.value: Request archived records from the Building and Safety Records Division (Records@rivco.org, 951-955-2017) with the address or APN; a fee applies to copies or research. Before 1963, ask the Assessor for a CAP report.

value: Permit records before about 1963 were destroyed.
Only permits issued after 1997 are online; 1963-1997 permits need a records request.
Residential building plans are not kept: they are returned to the applicant or destroyed once the project is complete.
Permit Lookup is updated once a day and can be up to 24 hours behind.
